test_ContiguousMemmap_roundtrip: test ContiguousMemmap roundtrip by dumping a numpy array and verifying shape, dtype, and data equality
test_ContiguousMemmap_view_ops: test ContiguousMemmap view operations like transpose, reshape, swapaxes, ravel, and squeeze for correct data
test_DumpContext_options_replace: test DumpContext options replace to remap MemmapArray handler to ContiguousMemmapArray on dump and load
test_ContiguousMemmap_indexing_errors: test ContiguousMemmap indexing to verify fancy indexing and non-contiguous slices raise TypeError
test_ContiguousMemmap_no_shared_memory: test ContiguousMemmap does not share memory with underlying memmap by verifying file I/O materialization
